thread:
anita: quick question for SDK maintainers — after merging #455 in ruby-sdk (default retry/backoff tweak), our ruby quickstart seems to retry much more aggressively than the node sample. curious if that's expected or a config bug.
sam: which defaults did we change in #455? I skimmed but didn't catch the exact numbers.
anita: PR sets: ```DEFAULT_MAX_RETRIES = 5
DEFAULT_INITIAL_BACKOFF_MS = 100
DEFAULT_MAX_BACKOFF_MS = 5000
BACKOFF_MULTIPLIER = 2.0```
node's defaults (from memory) are 3 retries, initial 200ms, multiplier 1.5. so ruby will backoff faster but allow more attempts.
yuri: hmm, that mismatch is intentional-ish: ruby historically had more conservative retry count because many customers use smaller requests and expect redelivery. but we should aim for cross-SDK parity in surface behavior.
anita: users following the quickstart get surprised because error patterns differ between SDKs. support pinged a user who assumed SDKs would behave the same.
sam: recommend we do one of: 1) align ruby defaults to node, 2) document the difference clearly in the changelog/README, or 3) expose a shared config helper across SDKs.
yuri: i'm +1 for aligning defaults for beta parity. less surprising. but we need an internal note explaining why previous defaults existed.
anita: i'll open a tiny PR to adjust ruby to node's numbers and include a migration note in the changelog. also we should add a short unit/integration test that compares a deterministic retry schedule to a golden file.
sam: test sounds great. could use a fake time advance or stub sleep. keep tests fast.
yuri: also add a one-liner in the sampleapp README pointing to the SDK retry config so users know where to tweak it.
anita: ok opening PR now: https://github.com/redwood-inference/ruby-sdk/pull/462 
ci-bot: Workflow run started for PR #462 — ruby-lint, unit, integration-fast
anita: added tests asserting schedule: `[100,200,400,800]` for initial=100, multiplier=2, max_retries=4 — will change to `[200,300,450]` when aligning to node defaults (initial=200, multiplier=1.5, max_retries=3).
sam: nit: when you change code, add a tiny comment in the retry implementation referencing the cross-SDK parity doc (`docs/sdk-parity.md`) so future maintainers don't diverge unknowingly.
yuri: thanks, team. once CI passes we can merge and backport to the sampleapp quickstart. :thumbsup:
ci-bot: All checks passed for PR #462
anita: merged and backported to quickstart. will follow up with a short support note and changelog entry.
